chunks: From him, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from 'Isa ibn al-Qasim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
I had breakfast with him, and he said: 'This is Shirazi utun (a type of bread), we have kept it for one of our sick people. If you wish to eat from it, then eat.'

key_terms.شِيرَازُ الْأُتُنِ: Shirazi utun, a type of bread from Shiraz
key_terms.لِمَرِيضٍ لَنَا: For one of our sick people

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the reserved bread for the sick?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* illustrates the practical application of ownership rights (*milk*) and the permissibility of sharing reserved provisions (*khas*) with the owner's consent. It highlights the Imam’s generosity and the social etiquette of accepting food, reinforcing that reserved items do not become impermissible for others unless explicitly withheld.
